description: Data-defined code fixes for GSharp (ADR-0227 D6): transformation programs, their JSON schema and the provider that interprets them.

A Result pattern for .NET built on C# 15 unions: Result<T>, Result and Error with typed categories, railway composition (Map, Bind, Ensure, Tap, Match), async pipelines, CombineAll validation and exception boundaries.
gRPC integration for ResultUnion: Error to and from google.rpc.Status (ErrorInfo, BadRequest, RetryInfo), GetValueOrThrowRpc for services and RpcException.ToError for clients.
ASP.NET Core integration for ResultUnion: typed Minimal API results (Results<Ok<T>, ProblemHttpResult>) and RFC 9457 problem details with field errors, codes and arguments.
ABC notation for MusicTheory: reads single-voice ABC tunes into spelled notes, durations and measures.
ChordPro for MusicTheory: parses chord sheets into lines and chord segments and writes them back byte for byte.
Standard MIDI files for MusicTheory: writes measures, a tempo map and a key as a format 1 file.
MusicXML for MusicTheory: writes measures, key, meter and title as partwise MusicXML 4.0 with System.Xml.Linq.
Add fan operations to MinimalRabbit. This package adds fan operations that are saved on the file system.
